title: Order Credits Coming Off Authorization Corrections — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — authorization corrections (CO-197).** The test charge credits on the patient's order under **Laboratory Test Orders** (the order the corrected claim bills) can come off an authorization correction.

## Clause

The order's credits enter the authorization correction only when the order's most recent credit was posted after the claim's filing date:

(a) where any credit on the order is for a test not performed or a duplicate test, every credit on the order comes off;
(b) where the order carries billing-correction credits only and their total reaches the authorization correction's credit minimum, the billing-correction credits come off;
(c) otherwise nothing comes off.

A credit posted on the filing date itself is not posted after it.

## Input, judgement, output

```
Input:  date of the order's most recent credit; credit reasons and amounts on the order
Judge:  most recent credit later than the filing date?
          no  -> nothing comes off
          yes -> any test-not-performed or duplicate-test credit?
                   yes -> every credit on the order comes off
                   no  -> billing-correction total reaches the credit minimum?
                            yes -> the billing-correction credits come off
                            no  -> nothing comes off
Output: the credits that come off
```

## Hypothetical orders

- Most recent credit after filing; a test-not-performed credit of 60.00 USD and a billing-correction credit of 10.00 USD: 70.00 USD comes off.
- Most recent credit after filing; billing-correction credits of 2.00 USD only, credit minimum 3.00 USD: nothing comes off.
- Most recent credit on the filing date; a duplicate-test credit of 45.00 USD: nothing comes off.
